title: Simulation by the Capture-Wrapped Evaluator
statement: Let $M$ be a finite-state Boolean Turing machine, let $w$ and $s$ be Boolean words, and let $c$ be a configuration of $M$ on input $s$. Suppose $b$ correctly marks the boundary of the input-head position of $c$, $p$ is a physical input-head position on $w$, and the run from $c$ remains live at every time $j<t$. Then there is a Boolean tag $b'$ correctly marking the input-head position at time $t$ such that running the capture-wrapped evaluator for $t$ steps from the evaluator configuration associated with $c$, $b$, and $p$ gives exactly the evaluator configuration associated with the time-$t$ configuration of $M$, tag $b'$, and the same physical position $p$.
hypotheses_covered: M is a finite-state Boolean Turing machine
w and s are Boolean words
c is a configuration of M on input s
b is a valid boundary tag for c's input-head position
p is a valid physical input-head position on w
M remains live at every time j less than t
replaced:
Let $M$ be a bundled finite machine, $c$ a configuration of $M$ on a simulated argument
carrying a valid virtual boundary tag, and $t$ a time before which the run of $M$ from
$c$ stays live. Then there is a valid tag for the endpoint such that running the
capture-wrapped evaluator for $t$ steps from the evaluator configuration of $c$ equals
the evaluator configuration of the run of $M$ from $c$ at time $t$.
